बॉलीवु़ड के गलियारों से आ गई है एकदम चटपटी खबर! 🍿
रामायण में मां सीता का किरदार निभा रहीं Sai Pallavi ने सेट का एक इमोशनल किस्सा शेयर किया है। 🎬
कंटेंट क्रिएटर Pallavi Raj से बात करते हुए उन्होंने बताया कि शूटिंग के दौरान एक सीन के बाद उनकी डायलॉग कोच ने उनके पैर छू लिए थे। 🙏
Sai Pallavi का कहना है कि वह यह सब देखकर हैरान रह गईं और अपनी भावनाओं पर काबू नहीं रख पाईं और रोने लगीं। 🥺
उन्होंने कहा कि जब आप किसी ऐसे किरदार को निभाते हैं जिसे आप रोज पूजते हैं, तो लोग एक्टर को भूलकर उस भावना से जुड़ जाते हैं। ✨
इससे पहले KBC में भी उन्होंने कहा था कि इस बार उन्होंने सीता मां का रोल निभाते वक्त अपना दिमाग नहीं लगाया बल्कि सिर्फ प्रक्रिया को पारदर्शी रखा। 📺
Nitesh Tiwari के निर्देशन में बन रही इस फिल्म में Ranbir Kapoor राम के रोल में और Yash रावण के रोल में नजर आएंगे। 🏹
आपको क्या लगता है, परदे पर यह जोड़ी कितना धमाल मचाएगी? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Sai Pallavi recalls crying on Ramayana sets after dialect coach touched her feet
ctx.summary: Sai Pallavi recalled being moved when her dialect coach touched her feet after a scene in Ramayana.
ctx.text:
Playing mythological characters on the big screen comes with its own set of challenges, especially when the character is widely revered. In a recent interaction, Sai Pallavi , who plays Goddess Sita in Ramayana , spoke about an emotional moment on the film's sets. She recalled how she broke down after her dialect coach touched her feet following a scene in which she portrayed Sita.
In a conversation with content creator Pallavi Raj, Sai Pallavi opened up about a moment that left her feeling “a bit overwhelmed” while shooting the film.
“The moment when I was a bit overwhelmed was when my dialect coach, she actually touched my feet after a scene, and I was taken aback because she saw me making phone calls, getting ready and all of that. She (the dialect coach) knows I am Sai Pallavi, but sometimes when you play a character that you worship every day, when you have a connection with it like your mother, and when somebody embodies it, you do not care about whether that's an actor or any other human being. You just want that love.”
She added, “So when she did that, even before she started to cry, I started to cry. I said, 'What are you even doing?' So it's just that moment made me feel the character speaks so much more to so many people. I was very humbled and overwhelmed to experience that amount of love.”
Earlier, during her appearance on Kaun Banega Crorepati with Ravi Dubey and Ranbir Kapoor, Sai spoke about playing the role of Maa Sita. She said, “I didn’t want to use my head this time. Every time when I play a character, I think what can I give to that character, but this was the first time when I thought - 'What can I get for playing a role like that of Sita Maa? Like what knowledge will I gain from this?' So, I wanted to keep the process transparent. I didn’t want to think anything about it. I prayed to Sita Maa and went forward with it.”
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. The film, produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, has crossed ₹ 1000 crore mark worldwide at the box office.

Though she holds a Commerce degree, she discovered her true calling in journalism after enrolling at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC). She began her career covering Delhi's cultural scene, food, nightlife, concerts, and city life at The Times of India, before moving into full-time entertainment journalism with India Today.

At India Today, Vibha interviewed some of the biggest names in Bollywood and television while carving a niche for herself through film reviews, opinion pieces, nostalgic features, celebrity interviews, and trend-driven stories.
